question: Which among the following famous temples is located in Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamakhya Temple.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kamakhya Temple:-**

 
 
• **The Kamakhya Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to the goddess Kamakhya, located on the Nilachal Hill in Guwahati, Assam, India. **
 
• It is one of the oldest and most revered centers of Tantric practices.
 
• It is considered to be one of the 51 Shakti Peethas, or "seats of power," associated with the goddess Shakti.
 
• The temple is believed to be the place where the yoni, or womb, of the goddess Sati fell after she was immolated on the funeral pyre of her husband, the god Shiva.
 
• The yoni is represented by a natural spring that flows from a cave within the temple complex. This spring is known as the Kamakhya Gupha, or "Kamakhya Cave," and is said to have healing powers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Somnath Temple:-

 
 
• It​ is located in Gujarat and is one of the 12 Jyotirlinga shrines dedicated to Lord Shiva.
 
 
 
• Shore Temple:-
 
 
• It​ is located in Mahabalipuram, Tamil Nadu and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its Dravidian architecture.
 
 
 
• Mundeshwari Temple:-
 
 
• It​ is located in Bihar and is one of the oldest Hindu temples in India.
